- Remain on plan item 2 until its source/deployment identity and performance evidence are resolved.
- The live CSP/404 defects are corrected at source and deployed:
  - allow only `wss://*.supabase.co` for Supabase realtime;
  - use GET for the GET-only waitlist stats route;
  - probe `/health`, not `/api/`.
- Do not treat direct deployment as sufficient proof: commit, GitHub `main` parity, and production artifact identity are still required.
- Treat the intentional `no-cors` health warm-up `net::ERR_ABORTED` separately from actual failed HTTP requests.
- Use local Lighthouse as equivalent performance evidence because PageSpeed public API was quota-limited (`429`).
- Keep worker work limited to non-financial `qa_only` actions until signed single-use approval completion is proven.
- Present 1099/tax output only as accounting support/tax-preparation data, never tax filing/compliance.

1. Inspect the Supabase `landing_analytics` abort and verify whether it is intentional/non-critical or fix it.
